import os
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE','config.settings')
import django
django.setup()
from django.db import connection
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from django.utils import timezone
from datetime import timedelta
from uuid import uuid4
executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
old=[('safety','0070_purposerestrictionread_purposereleaseproposal')]
executor.migrate(old)
apps=executor.loader.project_state(old).apps
get=lambda name:apps.get_model('safety',name)
user=apps.get_model('core','User').objects.create(username='synthetic-migration-only',email='migration@example.invalid')
now=timezone.now()
case=get('RightsRequest').objects.create(submission_key=uuid4(),account_subject=user,received_at=now,initial_due_at=now+timedelta(days=30),receipt_expires_at=now+timedelta(days=30))
proof=get('RightsProof').objects.create(key=uuid4(),request=case,account_subject=user,initiated_by=user,case_version=1,expires_at=now+timedelta(days=1))
def action():return get('RightsAction').objects.create(key=uuid4(),request=case,actor=user,expected_version=1)
plan=get('ProcessingPurposePlan').objects.create(action=action(),proof=proof,account_subject=user)
review=get('ProcessingPlanReview').objects.create(action=action(),plan=plan,proof=proof,outcome='approved')
execution=get('ProcessingExecution').objects.create(action=action(),review=review,proof=proof,account_subject=user)
day=now.date()-timedelta(days=7)
measure=get('PurposeRestriction').objects.create(execution=execution,subject=user,purpose='account_preferences',mode='restrict',review_on=day)
executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
new=[('safety','0071_purposerestriction_initial_review_on_and_more')]
executor.migrate(new)
updated=executor.loader.project_state(new).apps.get_model('safety','PurposeRestriction').objects.get(pk=measure.pk)
assert updated.initial_review_on==day and updated.review_on==day and updated.active and updated.version==1
print('Nonempty0070→0071: original date preserved, active/version1 unchanged')
